text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Some 20 plywood factory operators in the Sabah town of Sandakan have decided to cut down production by about 40 percent from Sunday due to lower demand and unstable prices.

-- The aim of agriculture bank, Bank Pertanian, to be a full-fledged commercial bank is expected to be realised soon with its privatisation plans submitted to the government, said its general manager Mohd Rosli Abdul Aziz.

-- The Port Klang Shipping Agencies Association and Association of Forwarding Agents Port Klang, representatives of shippers and forwarding agents at Malaysia's key port, call on importers and exporters to use local ports more and use less of rival port Singapore.
